# Validation fixtures

Fixtures are deterministic, fictional, and redistributable under Apache-2.0.

The Python suite currently includes a constant-width analytic circle request and a stable result-contract snapshot under `tests/python/fixtures`; geometry, crossing, orientation, acceleration, braking, friction, failure-state, and API cases are also built directly in focused tests. New public files must document units, source/provenance, expected properties, and tolerances.
